from solution import find_rotation_count


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: [8, 9, 10, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] has 3 rotations."""
    expected = 3  # hand count min 1 at index 3; 2+1=3
    assert find_rotation_count([8, 9, 10, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]) == expected


def test_issue_sorted_no_rotation():
    """Circularly sorted array with no rotation has count 0."""
    expected = 0  # min 1 at index 0; 1-1=0
    assert find_rotation_count([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) == expected


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Single element array has 0 rotations."""
    expected = 0  # min at index 0; 1-1=0
    assert find_rotation_count([42]) == expected


def test_issue_empty():
    """Empty array has 0 rotations."""
    expected = 0  # no elements, 0 rotations; 1-1=0
    assert find_rotation_count([]) == expected


def test_issue_rotated_by_one():
    """Array [5, 1, 2, 3, 4] has 1 rotation."""
    expected = 1  # min 1 at index 1; 0+1=1
    assert find_rotation_count([5, 1, 2, 3, 4]) == expected


def test_issue_rotated_by_n_minus_one():
    """Array [2, 3, 4, 5, 1] of length 5 has 4 rotations."""
    expected = 4  # n=5, n-1=4; 5-1=4
    assert find_rotation_count([2, 3, 4, 5, 1]) == expected


def test_issue_middle_rotation():
    """Array [4, 5, 6, 1, 2, 3] has 3 rotations."""
    expected = 3  # min 1 at index 3; 2+1=3
    assert find_rotation_count([4, 5, 6, 1, 2, 3]) == expected


def test_issue_two_elements_rotated():
    """Array [2, 1] has 1 rotation."""
    expected = 1  # min 1 at index 1; 0+1=1
    assert find_rotation_count([2, 1]) == expected


def test_issue_all_equal():
    """Circularly sorted array with all equal values has 0 rotations."""
    expected = 0  # min at index 0; 1-1=0
    assert find_rotation_count([3, 3, 3, 3]) == expected


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """find_rotation_count(A) must return the count as an int."""
    result = find_rotation_count([8, 9, 10, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7])  # 2+1=3 items checked
    assert isinstance(result, int)


def test_contract_does_not_modify_input():
    """find_rotation_count(A) must not modify the input list."""
    data = [4, 5, 1, 2, 3]  # len 5; 4+1=5
    snapshot = [4, 5, 1, 2, 3]  # copy; 4+1=5
    find_rotation_count(data)
    assert data == snapshot
